description: This file defines models and logic for managing employee holidays, including holiday statuses, user-specific holiday limits, holiday requests, and logs within an Odoo module.

classes.name: hr_holidays_status
classes.description: Model representing different types of holiday statuses with color coding and override options.

classes.name: hr_holidays_per_user
classes.description: Model tracking maximum and remaining leaves per employee and holiday status.

classes.name: hr_holidays
classes.description: Main model for holiday requests, including validation, state transitions, and related logic.

classes.name: holiday_user_log
classes.description: Model for logging actions related to holiday requests.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieves employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: strToDate
methods.description: Converts a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format to a date object.

methods.name: _get_remaining_leaves
methods.description: Calculates remaining leaves for a user and holiday status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new record, associating user ID with employee.

methods.name: _update_user_holidays
methods.description: Updates the leaves taken or resets holiday data upon request cancellation or validation.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that holiday date ranges and number of days are consistent.

methods.name: _create_holiday
methods.description: Associates a holiday request with the employee's holiday records.

methods.name: onchange_date_to
methods.description: Automatically calculates number of days based on start and end dates.

methods.name: set_to_draft
methods.description: Resets a holiday request to draft state.

methods.name: holidays_validate
methods.description: Validates and confirms a holiday request, creating associated case and updating records.

methods.name: holidays_confirm
methods.description: Confirms a holiday request, setting user and state.

methods.name: holidays_refuse
methods.description: Refuses a holiday request, updating state and manager.

methods.name: holidays_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a holiday request and updates related records.

methods.name: holidays_draft
methods.description: Resets a holiday request to draft state.

methods.name: check_holidays
methods.description: Checks if holiday request exceeds available leaves and creates or updates case records accordingly.
